Veteran Marathi Actress Madhu Kambikar Dies at 73

Veteran Marathi actress Madhu Kambikar passed away on October 12 at the age of 73. She was known for her work in over 75 Marathi films, including 'Shaapit', 'Hech Majha Maher', 'Raghumaina', 'Ek Hota Vidushak', 'Zapatlela', and 'Debu'. Kambikar also had a notable career as a Lavani artiste. She had been battling health issues, including a stroke in 2016 that led to her being bedridden for several years, and died from age-related illness.
